key_impacts: PHIVOLCS issued tsunami alert level 3 prompting immediate evacuation of coastal areas in Eastern Samar and Leyte.
All surveyed barangays reported an estimated average of 80% of residents evacuated after the alert.
No significant tsunami wave appeared and no damages were observed.
Communication disruptions occurred: power cuts, mobile network issues, and an incorrect radio broadcast in one municipality.
Warning dissemination was delayed relative to expected wave arrival in some areas.
evidence_snippets: On 31 August 2012 a strong earthquake occurred in the Philippine Trench east of Eastern Samar.
At 09:01 pm PHIVOLCS issued alert level 3 (immediate evacuation) for coastal areas of Eastern Samar and Leyte.
All surveyed barangays had an estimated average of 80% of the residents evacuating after the alert.
missing_information: Sub-provincial affected locations and detailed evacuation timelines are limited.
